config.soft-steps-enchant.title: Soft Steps Config
config.soft-steps-enchant.option.obtainI: Can be obtained in loot chests?
config.soft-steps-enchant.tooltip.obtain:
Yes: Spawns in Ancient City loot chests.
No: Disables spawning in loot chests.
config.soft-steps-enchant.option.obtainI: Can be obtained in Enchanting Table?
config.soft-steps-enchant.tooltip.obtain:
Yes: Obtainable via Enchanting Table.
No: Disabled in Enchanting Table.
